book.name: ACTS
book.title: In o Oꞌohanas g Haꞌichu hab ha-Juni g Jesus Chuhchai

content: Matsh am i ha chuhcha g wewaꞌak chikpandam

Kush am i muꞌidahim hegam mash am oid g Jesus himdag. Sh am haꞌi neneok g Greek hemajkam ha‑neꞌokikaj nash pi tash gam hu kihkahim ha‑jewedga ed. Kush idam hab kaij mash pi ap ha dagioꞌid hegam heheꞌejel wiꞌikam uꞌuwi mash d ha‑hajuni. Kush heg hekaj am aꞌai pi e apꞌet idam Greek neneokdam ha wehm hegam mo g hejel e‑neꞌokikaj neneok.
Tsh am i kah g Jesus chuhchai k am wehs i ha hemapad k hab kaij, “T‑wepnag, pi o apꞌe machs wabsh wo dagito g mihshmda ab amjed g Jiosh k im hu g lial wo hudawogad.

Ab oki haꞌi ep em‑mahkch g Jiosh g gewkdag ch amichudadag mamt am hab wo junihid ihda chikpan. Pegih, mt am wewaꞌak wo i ha gawulkai hegam mam s‑ha mahch mo woho hab masma. Kutt idam am wo i ha chuhcha mat wo nuhkud ihda hab mahs haꞌichu.
Tt ahchim Jesus chuhchai am hab wo si i juh matt wo t‑hoꞌigeꞌidahunad ch wo si ha mihshmdad g hemajkam.” Neh, bash kaij.

Kumtsh ab si i s‑hohhoꞌi mo has kaij k am wewaꞌak i ha chuhcha. Hema idam ash hab chehgig Steven ch ab si s‑gewkam hiwig g Jesus. Sh g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag ab si mahkch g gewkdag. Kush hegam haꞌi ehp hab chechgig Philip ch Prochorus ch Nicanor ch Timon ch Parmenas ch Nicolaus. Ihda Nicolaus ash ab d amjedkam g Antiok kihhim ch d gawul mahs oꞌodham ch ab i s‑wohoch g Tutuligo ha‑himdag eda mat koi s‑mai ab amjed g Jesus.
Tsh idam ab hahawa i ha ui g hemajkam ha wui g Jesus chuhchai. Kutsh idam am e hoꞌigeꞌidahun k ab ha taht mat heg hekaj wo s‑e mahchk mo d si ha‑chuhchai.
Tsh am si i geꞌeda g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga Jerusalem t am. Kutsh baꞌich i muꞌida hegam mash am oid g Jesus himdag. Tsh muꞌijj ab i s‑wohoch hegam mo d papal Tutuligo ha‑himdag ed.
Ab ash si s‑hoꞌigeꞌid g Jiosh g Steven ch ab si i mahkch g e‑gewkdag. Kush s‑hasigam haꞌichu hab wua.

Tsh wabshaba haꞌi ab wui gegokiwua mash am hebai e wehm e mihshmad g Tuhligo e‑himdag. Haꞌi idam ash d neneholkahim Cyrene ch Alexandria kihhim t am. Tsh am haꞌi i ha wehmt ab Cilicia jewed t amjed ch haꞌi ab Asia jewed t amjed. Sh idam ab kamꞌon g Steven
Sh wabshaba g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag ab si mahkch g Steven g amichudadag. Kutsh pi shaꞌi e nako hegam mas ab uhpam wo i nodagi g neꞌokij.
k heg hekaj am hahawa haꞌi ha namkid k am ha ahgid mat hab wo chei, “Kah ach ihda mo si has ahg hegai mo ab t‑chehani g Jiosh Mosesbad oꞌohana ed.”
Kush wa woho hab kaij idam ch hekaj i ha kudu g hemajkam ch geꞌeged ch chehanig ha mashchamdam. Tsh idam wabsh woho i babgat k am hihim k an bei g Steven k ged hu uꞌapa ha wui g e jehnigiddam.

Mtsh am hahawa haꞌi i ha wahpki g oꞌodham matsh am haꞌichu wo ha iattogi ab amjed. Sh hab kaij idam, “Ihda oꞌodham o chum hekid has ahg g hekia s‑apꞌekam geꞌe cheopi ch hegai mo ab t‑chehani g Jiosh Mosesbad oꞌohana ed.
Kah ach mo hab kaij mat hegai Jesusbad wo i wua g geꞌe cheopi k wo gawul juh g t‑himdag mach ga hu hebai amjed hab i junihim mat g Mosesbad an oꞌoha.”
Kush wehsijj ab si neid g Steven. Sh g wuhioshaj hab haha wabsh mahs matp hems g anghil wuhiosha nash pi si tonod.
